title: 3commerce — SLOs (ADR-0029)
description: The ADR-0029 service-level objectives per service: availability >= 99.5 % over 30 days (request-based: share of HTTP requests that are not 5xx), its error budget (0.5 %) and the burn rate, and p95 latency for reads (catalog < 500 ms, everything else < 800 ms). Thresholds and expressions are the SAME as the provisioned alert rules (provisioning/alerting/rules.yml: tc-http-5xx-rate, tc-p95-catalog-reads, tc-p95-other-reads), so a red panel here and an alert email always agree. Queries Mimir (uid mimir). Deploy markers (ADR-0069) show when a new service.version starts.

list.name: Deploys (new service.version, ADR-0069)
list.expr: group by (service_name, service_version, vcs_ref_head_revision, deployment_environment_name) (dotnet_process_cpu_time_seconds_total) unless group by (service_name, service_version, vcs_ref_head_revision, deployment_environment_name) (dotnet_process_cpu_time_seconds_total offset 15m)

options.content: **Availability** = share of HTTP requests that are not 5xx, over 30 days; objective **99.5 %** (ADR-0029), so the **error budget** is 0.5 % of requests. **Burn rate** = current 5xx ratio / 0.5 %: 1 spends the budget exactly in 30 days; the alert `HTTP 5xx rate above 1 %` (5 min) is burn rate 2; 6 over 6 h or 14.4 over 1 h are the classic multi-window "budget gone in days / hours" lines. **Latency**: p95 of GET requests per route, catalog < 500 ms (NFR-5), everything else < 800 ms — the same expressions as the latency alerts. Runbook: `docs/runbooks/observability.md`.

targets.expr: 1 - ((sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[30d])) or on (service_name) (0 * sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[30d])))) / sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[30d])))

panels.title: Error budget remaining, 30 days
panels.description: 1 - (5xx ratio over 30 days / 0.5 %). Below 0: the objective is missed for the window.

targets.expr: 1 - (((sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[30d])) or on (service_name) (0 * sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[30d])))) / sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[30d]))) / 0.005)

panels.title: Error-budget burn rate (1 h and 6 h windows)
panels.description: 5xx ratio over the window / 0.5 % (the budget). 1 = budget spent exactly in 30 days. The 5-minute 5xx > 1 % alert is burn rate 2; 6 (6 h) and 14.4 (1 h) mark a budget gone in ~5 days / ~2 days.

targets.expr: ((sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[1h])) or on (service_name) (0 * sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[1h])))) / sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[1h]))) / 0.005

((sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[6h])) or on (service_name) (0 * sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[6h])))) / sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[6h]))) / 0.005

panels.title: 5xx ratio, 5 min (alert: > 1 % for 5 min)
panels.description: Exactly the expression of the alert rule tc-http-5xx-rate (near-idle services, < ~15 requests per 5 min, are ignored as there).

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[5m]))) and on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[5m])) > 0.05)

panels.title: p95 latency, catalog reads (SLO < 500 ms)
panels.description: Exactly the expression of the alert rule tc-p95-catalog-reads (GET, per route); the alert fires after 10 min above the line.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="catalog", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_request_method="GET"}[5m])))

panels.title: p95 latency, other reads (SLO < 800 ms)
panels.description: Exactly the expression of the alert rule tc-p95-other-reads (GET, per service and route, catalog excluded); the alert fires after 10 min above the line.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name!="catalog", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_request_method="GET"}[5m])))

panels.title: Latency SLO headroom now (p95 / target, worst route per service)
panels.description: Worst GET route p95 divided by its target (catalog 0.5 s, others 0.8 s), over the last 30 min. Above 1 = the SLO is missed right now.

targets.expr: max by (service_name) (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="catalog", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_request_method="GET"}[30m]))) / 0.5) or max by (service_name) (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name!="catalog", service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_request_method="GET"}[30m]))) / 0.8)
